# Daily Report — 2026-08-01

## Task Completed
Added `update_on_call_rotation_member` and `delete_on_call_rotation` tools to complete the on-call rotation management surface.

**`update_on_call_rotation_member`** — PATCH `cmn_rota_member/{sys_id}`: updates a rotation member slot's assigned user, order position, active flag, catch_all flag, override_on_call_rota reference, or skills field. Empty-body guard returns a clear error. 404 guard returns a not-found message. Reference fields in the response are normalised to display values.

**`delete_on_call_rotation`** — DELETE `cmn_rota/{sys_id}`: accepts rotation by sys_id or exact name (resolves via `_resolve_on_call_rotation_sys_id`). Handles 204 No Content and 200 success. 404 guard on both the name-resolve step and the delete step.

Both tools registered in `__init__.py`, `tool_utils.py`, and `tool_packages.yaml` (system_administrator + full packages).
